exercises.title: My Dream Pet
prompts: Which pet would you like to have and why?
How would you take care of your pet?
Why do some people prefer cats over dogs?

structureTips.title: Misol keltir
structureTips.detail: Uy hayvonini parvarishlashni "For example..." deb misol bilan tushuntir.

structureTips.title: Fikr bildir
structureTips.detail: Javobingni "I think..." deb orzuingdagi uy hayvoni haqida boshla.

structureTips.title: Boshqalar fikri
structureTips.detail: Odamlar nega mushuklarni tanlashini "Some people think..." deb ayt.

structureTips.title: Xulosa qil
structureTips.detail: Oxirida "Overall..." deb sodiq do'sting haqida qisqa xulosa qil.

exercises.title: Environmental Problems
prompts: What environmental problems can you see in the picture?
How can we protect nature?

structureTips.title: Misol keltir
structureTips.detail: Ifloslanishga "For example" deb plastik shishalarni misol qil.

structureTips.title: Sababini tushuntir
structureTips.detail: Plastik zararli ekanini "because" so'zi orqali tushuntir.

structureTips.title: Xulosa qil
structureTips.detail: Tabiatni asrash bo'yicha oxirida "Overall" deb xulosa ayt.

exercises.title: Takrorlang: My Pet
exercises.targetText: My dog is very friendly and he likes to play in the garden every morning.

exercises.title: My Favorite School Subject
prompts: Which school subject do you think is the most useful?
Can you give an example of what you learn in this class?
Why is this subject important for all students?

exercises.title: Healthy Food Choice
prompts: Do you prefer eating healthy food or fast food?
Can you give an example of healthy food and explain why it is good for your body?
What do your parents or friends say about healthy food?

exercises.title: My Favorite Hobby
prompts: Which activity do you like best: reading books, playing sports, or drawing pictures?
Why do you like it, and what do your friends prefer to do in their free time?
Why is having a good hobby important for everyone?

exercises.title: Books Or Phones
prompts: Do you prefer reading paper books or reading on a phone?
Can you give an example of a good book and explain why reading helps us?
What do your friends or family think about reading?

exercises.title: Safe Internet Use
prompts: Do you think the internet is helpful or dangerous for young students?
What is a good example of using the internet safely?
Why should students limit their screen time every day?

exercises.title: Sports And Healthy Life
prompts: Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?
What is your favorite sport and why is it good for your health?
What do your friends or family think about playing sports?

exercises.title: Takrorlang: Our School
exercises.targetText: Every morning the children go to their big school with their good friends.

exercises.title: Adventure Under the Sea
prompts: Tell a story about an adventure under the sea.
What did the diver discover?

structureTips.title: Ketma-ketlik
structureTips.detail: "First...", "Then..." va "After that..." so'zlari bilan g'avvos sarguzashtini tartib bilan ayt.

exercises.title: The Day of Emotions
prompts: Tell a story about a day full of different emotions.
How did the person feel in the morning, afternoon and evening?

structureTips.title: His-tuyg'ular
structureTips.detail: Kunning har xil vaqtida o'zingni "excited" his qilganingni ayt.

structureTips.title: Voqealar tartibi
structureTips.detail: Voqealarni "First", "Then" va "After that" so'zlari bilan tartiblab ayt.

exercises.title: An Exciting Train Journey
prompts: Can you tell a story about a memorable train journey?
What unexpected thing happened on the train and who was there?
How did you feel during the trip and how did it end?

exercises.title: Finding A Lost Thing
prompts: What important thing did you lose, and how did you feel at first?
Where did you look for it, and who helped you?
Where was it hidden, and how did the story end?

exercises.title: A Special Rainy Day
prompts: Where were you and what happened when it started raining?
What fun things did you do inside, and how did you feel?
How did the day end and what did you learn?

exercises.title: Helping A Kind Neighbor
prompts: When did you help a neighbor or a stranger?
What did the person look like and how did you feel?
How did your story end and what lesson did you learn?

exercises.title: My Space Adventure
prompts: How did you feel when you started your journey into space in a rocket?
What did the new planet look like and what did you do there?
What interesting thing did you discover before coming home?

exercises.title: Takrorlang: Forest Adventure
exercises.targetText: Yesterday we went to a big green forest and saw a fast red fox.

exercises.title: Famous Landmarks
prompts: Describe this famous landmark.
Why do people visit this place?

structureTips.title: Ko'rganingni tasvirla
structureTips.detail: Obidani tasvirlash uchun gapingni "I can see a landmark" deb boshla.

structureTips.title: Joyini ko'rsat
structureTips.detail: Sayyohlar joylashuvini tasvirlash uchun "in front of..." iborasidan foydalan.

exercises.title: Family Album
prompts: Describe this family photo.
What are the people doing and how do they feel?

structureTips.title: Rasmni tasvirlash
structureTips.detail: Suratda kimlar borligini "I can see my family" deb tasvirlab ber.

structureTips.title: Kayfiyatni aytish
structureTips.detail: Suratdagi insonlar o'zini qanday his qilayotganini "they feel happy" deb ayt.

structureTips.title: Joyni ko'rsatish
structureTips.detail: Oila a'zolari qayerda turganini "on the left" iborasi bilan ko'rsat.

exercises.title: Busy City Street
prompts: What do you see in this busy city street?
Who are the people, what are they wearing, and how do they feel?
What shops, buildings, and transport can you see around them?

exercises.title: At The Busy Market
prompts: What do you see at this colorful market?
What are people doing on the left and right?
How do the buyers and sellers feel today?

exercises.title: Autumn In The Park
prompts: What season do you see in this picture?
What colors are the clothes and background?
What are the people doing and how do they feel?

exercises.title: Our Busy Classroom
prompts: Who is in the classroom and what do they look like?
Where are the people and what objects can you see around them?
How do the students feel and why is this a nice classroom?

exercises.title: Takrorlang: Green park
exercises.targetText: In the big green park, there are three happy children playing with a red ball.

dialogs.title: New Friend at School
dialogs.intro: Hi! I'm Alex. I'm new at this school. Nice to meet you!

turns.characterLine: What games do you usually play on the playground?
turns.studentHint: Alex'ga qanday o'yinlar o'ynashingizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: That sounds fun! Can you show me how to play hopscotch?
turns.studentHint: Klass o'yinini qanday o'ynashni tushuntiring.

turns.characterLine: Great! Where can we find something to eat at break time?
turns.studentHint: Maktab oshxonasi haqida ayting.

turns.characterLine: Thank you for helping me. Will you be my friend?
turns.studentHint: Alex'ning savoliga xushmuomalalik bilan javob bering.

dialogs.title: At the Electronics Store
dialogs.intro: Welcome to our electronics store! How can I help you today?

turns.characterLine: We have many gadgets. What are you looking for?
turns.studentHint: Qaysi gadjetni sotib olmoqchi ekaningizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: Good choice! What features are important for you?
turns.studentHint: Sizga muhim bo'lgan xususiyatlarni tasvirlang.

turns.characterLine: This model costs 200 dollars. Would you like to buy it?
turns.studentHint: Narx haqida savol bering yoki qaror qiling.

turns.characterLine: Thank you for your purchase! Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Sotuvchiga rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: At the Doctor's Office
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am Doctor Jasur. Please come in and sit down.

turns.characterLine: Hello! How are you feeling today?
turns.studentHint: Shifokorga salom bering va o'zingizni yomon his qilayotganingizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: Oh, I am sorry. What is the problem? What hurts?
turns.studentHint: Shamollaganingizni, boshingiz va tomog'ingiz og'riyotganini tushuntiring.

turns.characterLine: I see. You should rest. Do you have a fever?
turns.studentHint: Isitmangiz borligini ayting va dori olishingiz kerakligini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Yes, take this medicine twice a day and drink warm tea. Get well soon!
turns.studentHint: Shifokorga maslahat uchun rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Ordering at a Cafe
dialogs.intro: Hello! Welcome to Smart Cafe. I am Jasur, your waiter.

turns.characterLine: Hello! Welcome to our cafe. Here is the menu. What would you like to drink?
turns.studentHint: Kafeda ichimlik (masalan, suv, choy yoki sharbat) so'rang va 'iltimos' deb ayting.

turns.characterLine: Great choice! And what food would you like to eat today?
turns.studentHint: O'zingiz xohlagan taomni (masalan, pitsa, burger yoki salat) buyurtma qiling.

turns.characterLine: Here is your delicious meal! Would you like anything else, or the bill?
turns.studentHint: Rahmat ayting va hisob/narxni so'rang.

turns.characterLine: The total is 50,000 sums. Thank you for coming! Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Pulni bering, rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Asking for Directions
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am Jasur. I am walking in the city center today.

turns.characterLine: Hello! You look lost. Can I help you?
turns.studentHint: Salomlashing va uzr so'rab, sizga yordam kerakligini ayting (masalan: Hello, excuse me, please help).

turns.characterLine: Of course! Where do you want to go?
turns.studentHint: Tarix muzeyi qayerdaligini so'rang (masalan: Where is the history museum?).

turns.characterLine: Go straight and turn left. It is near the big park. Is there anything else?
turns.studentHint: Piyoda borishga qancha vaqt ketishini so'rang (masalan: How many minutes to walk?).

turns.characterLine: It takes about five minutes. It is very close. Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Yordam uchun kattakon rahmat ayting va xayrlashing (masalan: Thank you very much, goodbye).

dialogs.title: Sports Star Interview
dialogs.intro: Hello! I'm Sara, a professional tennis player. I'm ready for your questions!

turns.characterLine: I started playing tennis when I was seven years old.
turns.studentHint: U qachon tennis o'ynay boshlaganini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: I train for four hours every day, in the morning and afternoon.
turns.studentHint: Uning kunlik mashg'ulot tartibini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My most difficult match was the national final last year.
turns.studentHint: Eng qiyin o'yini haqida so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My advice is: practice every day and never give up.
turns.studentHint: Yosh o'yinchilarga qanday maslahat berishini so'rang.

dialogs.title: Family Responsibilities Interview
dialogs.intro: Hi! I'm your sister Dilnoza. Ask me about our home chores!

turns.characterLine: I usually wash the dishes and clean my room.
turns.studentHint: Uydagi qanday ishlarni bajarishini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: The most difficult task for me is cooking dinner.
turns.studentHint: Qaysi uy ishi eng qiyin ekanini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: We share the work — everyone helps a little every day.
turns.studentHint: Oilada ishlar qanday taqsimlanishini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Helping at home teaches us to be responsible and kind.
turns.studentHint: Nima uchun uyda yordam berish muhimligini so'rang.

conversations.title: Talking with Ben
conversations.goalUz: Ben bilan tanish, qiziqishlaring va maktabing haqida gapir, oxirida unga o'zing savol ber.

nodes.line: Hi! My name is Ben. I am eleven years old and I live in London. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is …"

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Tell me, what do you like doing in your free time?
nodes.hintUz: Bo'sh vaqtingda nima qilishni yoqtirasan? "I like …" deb boshla.

nodes.line: Sorry, I did not hear you well. Do you like sport, music, books or computer games?
nodes.hintUz: Yana bir marta ayt — sport, musiqa, kitob yoki kompyuter o'yinlari.

nodes.line: That is great! I play football every Saturday. How often do you do sport?
nodes.hintUz: Qanchalik tez-tez? "I play football every day" kabi javob ber.

nodes.line: Sport is really good for our health. Do you play with your friends or alone?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring bilanmi? Sababini ham qo'sh: "because …"

nodes.line: Wonderful! I play the guitar a little. What is your favourite song?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli qo'shiging yoki qo'shiqchingni ayt.

nodes.line: Nice choice! Do you listen to music when you do your homework?
nodes.hintUz: Dars qilayotganda musiqa eshitasanmi? "Yes, because …"

nodes.line: I love books too! What book are you reading now?
nodes.hintUz: Hozir qanday kitob o'qiyapsan?

nodes.line: That sounds interesting. Do you prefer paper books or reading on a phone?
nodes.hintUz: Qog'oz kitobmi yoki telefonda? Sababini ayt.

nodes.line: I see! What game do you play the most?
nodes.hintUz: Ko'proq qaysi o'yinni o'ynaysan?

nodes.line: Interesting. How much time do you spend on the computer every day?
nodes.hintUz: Kuniga qancha vaqt? "About one hour" kabi ayt.

nodes.line: Let me ask you about last weekend. What did you do on Sunday?
nodes.hintUz: O'tgan zamonda ayt: "I went …", "I played …", "I watched …"

nodes.line: Family time is the best. What did you eat together?
nodes.hintUz: Qanday taom yedinglar?

nodes.line: That sounds fun! Was the weather good on that day?
nodes.hintUz: Ob-havo qanday edi? "It was sunny/rainy/cold".

nodes.line: A calm weekend is also nice. What did you watch or read at home?
nodes.hintUz: Uyda nima qilding?

nodes.line: Now tell me about your school. What is your favourite subject?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli faning qaysi? "My favourite subject is …"

nodes.line: English is my favourite lesson too! Why do you like it?
nodes.hintUz: Nega yoqtirasan? "because" bilan tushuntir.

nodes.line: Wow, that is a difficult subject. Is it hard for you?
nodes.hintUz: Qiyinmi yoki osonmi? Sababini ayt.

nodes.line: Good choice. What do you usually do in that lesson?
nodes.hintUz: O'sha darsda nima qilasizlar?

nodes.line: Now it is your turn. Ask me a question about London or about me!
nodes.hintUz: Endi SEN savol ber! Masalan: "What is the weather like in London?"

nodes.line: You can ask me anything. For example: What is the weather like in London?
nodes.hintUz: Savolni shunday boshla: "What …?" yoki "Do you …?"

nodes.line: Good question! London is big and often rainy, but I love it. My favourite place is Hyde Park.
nodes.hintUz: Ben javob berdi — fikringni ayt yoki yana bir savol ber.

nodes.line: It was really nice talking to you today. Thank you and see you next time. Goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! It was nice to talk to you."

conversations.title: My School Day with Emma
conversations.goalUz: Ingliz tilida maktabing va darslaring haqida so'zlab ber va Emma bilan suhbatlash.

nodes.line: Hello! My name is Emma. I am 12 years old and I live in Manchester. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va o'z ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is …"

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Let us talk about school. What is your favorite subject?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli faning haqida ayt: "My favorite subject is …"

nodes.line: I did not hear you well. What subject do you like? Do you like Maths, English, or Art?
nodes.hintUz: Qaytadan ayt: "I like Maths", "I like English" yoki "I like Art".

nodes.line: Maths and Science are awesome! Do you like solving difficult problems in class?
nodes.hintUz: Javob ber: "Yes, I like solving problems" yoki "No, it is hard".

nodes.line: That is interesting! How many times a week do you have this lesson?
nodes.hintUz: Haftada necha marta bu dars bo'lishini ayt: "Three times a week" yoki "Every day".

nodes.line: English is great! Do you like reading English storybooks?
nodes.hintUz: Inglizcha kitob o'qishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "Yes, I read books" yoki "No, I do not".

nodes.line: That is nice! Who is your favorite teacher at school?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli o'qituvching haqida ayt: "My favorite teacher is …"

nodes.line: Art and Music are so fun! Do you like drawing pictures or singing songs?
nodes.hintUz: Rasm chizish yoki qo'shiq kuylashingni ayt: "I like drawing pictures".

nodes.line: Cool! Do you draw pictures with your friends in class?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring bilan chizishingni ayt: "Yes, with my friends" yoki "No, alone".

nodes.line: School days are full of fun! What do you usually do during the break time?
nodes.hintUz: Tanaffusda nima qilishingni ayt: "I eat a snack", "I play games" yoki "I talk with friends".

nodes.line: Eating snacks gives you energy! What food do you like to eat at school?
nodes.hintUz: Maktabda nima yeyishingni ayt: "I eat an apple" yoki "I eat bread".

nodes.line: Playing games is so exciting! Do you play football with your classmates?
nodes.hintUz: Futbol o'ynashingni ayt: "Yes, I play football" yoki "No, I play tag".

nodes.line: Talking with friends is wonderful! Do you have many close friends in your class?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring ko'pligini ayt: "Yes, I have many friends".

nodes.line: Friends make every day happier! How do you usually go to school in the morning?
nodes.hintUz: Maktabga qanday borishingni ayt: "I walk to school" yoki "I do homework at home".

nodes.line: Walking or going by bicycle is nice! Do you go to school with your friends or parents?
nodes.hintUz: Kim bilan borishingni ayt: "I go with my friends" yoki "With my father".

nodes.line: Doing homework and learning new things is super important! Do you study every evening?
nodes.hintUz: Kechqurun dars qilishingni ayt: "Yes, I study every evening".

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Do you have a question for me about my school in Manchester?
nodes.hintUz: Emmaga o'zing savol ber: "What is your favorite subject?" deb so'ra.

nodes.line: You can ask me anything! For example, ask me: 'What do you like to do at school?'
nodes.hintUz: Savol berishga harakat qil: "What do you like at school?"

nodes.line: My school in Manchester is very big and pretty! I love reading books and drawing pictures with my friends.
nodes.hintUz: Munosabat bildir: "That is great!" yoki "Very nice!" deb ayt.

nodes.line: It was really nice talking to you today! Thank you and see you next time. Goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! See you next time."
